findings.comment: Proposed buildings shown on site plan relative to existing overhead electric lines, but no clearance dimensions or profile views provided to verify 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor. Vertical clearance from overhead electric conductors to building faces cannot be verified from available plans.

Proposed customer facilities (buildings, utility infrastructure) shown relative to existing overhead distribution conductors, but no radial clearance dimensions or verification exhibited showing 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor in all directions. Conductor routing and facility locations not dimensioned.

applicableAreas: proposed buildings (all structures with roof/wall projections)
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing surveyed roof elevations, overhangs, balconies, and clearance dimensions to overhead electric conductors not provided. No profile views demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from building projections to outside conductor.

applicableAreas: proposed buildings adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way
findings.comment: Existing overhead electric facility poles and conductors located along Valley View Road right-of-way west of property. Proposed buildings shown on site plan without clearance dimensions demonstrating 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances are permanently maintained from outside conductor.

Building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors not provided. Required registered surveyor clearance data showing conductor heights and clearance verification to building faces and projections is absent from site plan submittal.

applicableAreas: proposed buildings and structures within potential clearance distance of overhead lines
findings.comment: Section and enlarged plan detail exhibits showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of proposed buildings and building projections not provided. Clearance verification dimensions required by code are absent from submitted plans.

applicableAreas: proposed and existing fences throughout property
findings.comment: Fences shown on site plan and landscape plan, but clearance dimensions from outside conductor of overhead electric facilities not labeled. Cannot verify that fences maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead lines crossing property.

applicableAreas: fence locations adjacent to utility poles along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Utility poles located along western property boundary adjacent to Valley View Road. Fences shown on plans, but specific dimension from pole centerline to nearest fence post not labeled to verify 10-foot minimum horizontal clearance maintained.

Retaining walls (maximum 14 feet height) proposed on site adjacent to overhead electric lines. Clearance dimensions from outside conductor to wall faces not shown on wall plan or landscape plan. Cannot verify 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors.

Section exhibits for retaining walls provided on Sheet 38, but dimensions from outside electric conductor to outermost edge of wall not included. Cross-sections do not show clearance verification from overhead conductors to wall faces.

Proposed driveways cross beneath or adjacent to existing overhead electric lines. Finished driveway grades shown on grading plan, but no profile sections showing vertical clearance dimensions from lowest point of overhead conductors and attachments to finished driveway surface. Cannot verify 16-foot or 18-foot minimum vertical clearance.

applicableAreas: all dimension annotations on site plan and utility plans
findings.comment: Plans show utility pole locations and approximate spacing from features (e.g., property line distances labeled), but no dimensions explicitly measuring clearances from outside conductor. If clearance dimensions were provided, they would need to originate from conductor location, not pole centerline; this requirement cannot be verified as no clearance dimensions are shown.

applicableAreas: sidewalks along Valley View Road frontage at property ends
findings.comment: Sidewalks proposed along Valley View Road where existing utility poles located at property lines. Clearance between sidewalk and pole locations not dimensioned. Cannot verify sidewalks are cleared from poles at each property end.

applicableAreas: proposed site features within potential clearance distance of overhead electric lines
findings.comment: No registered surveyor elevation data provided showing pole locations, overhead conductor elevations, and mid-span clearances. Proposed buildings have finish floor elevations ranging from 683.0 to 687.5 feet with building heights up to 36 feet 1 inch, bringing building peaks to approximately 719-725 feet. Existing overhead facility heights not surveyed; vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: landscape areas adjacent to overhead electric lines, southern portion of site
findings.comment: Mitigation trees and landscape plantings shown on landscape plan near overhead electric line. Tree species not explicitly identified against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible tree list. Tree locations relative to overhead conductors not dimensioned to verify 10-foot lateral distance requirement for distribution lines. Cannot confirm all proposed trees are utility-compatible species or maintain required clearances.

applicableAreas: utility poles with down guy wires along western property boundary
findings.comment: Existing survey shows utility poles with down guy wires and anchors adjacent to property. Proposed driveways, accessible paths, and site features shown on site plan, but specific locations of guy wire anchors not labeled and conflicts not addressed. Cannot verify down guy wires are not conflicting with proposed accessible routes and driveways, or that relocation/conversion has been resolved.

applicableAreas: down guy anchor points along utility poles on western boundary
findings.comment: Facts.md references plat-dedicated 5-foot electric easements (×2) from Mecey Subdivision, but extent and coverage of down guy anchor easements (10-foot width extending 5 feet past ground entry point per Austin Energy standards) not clearly delineated on submitted site plan or easement exhibit. Cannot verify adequate easement protection for down guy anchors.

applicableAreas: construction staging areas, equipment laydown zones
findings.comment: Erosion and sediment control plan shown, but no construction staging plan with identified equipment operation zones, material storage areas, or work platforms. No clearance dimensions shown verifying 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA 1910.333 and UCM § 1.10.2 during construction activities.

Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead electric lines. This notification requirement per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 must be added to cover sheet or general notes.
